cases.name: Formal React application boots at phone viewport
Demo route and reading position survive a reload
Materials are saved through the typed service
Voluntary reinforcement retains earlier evidence after a later incorrect answer
Question form renders the answer in the correct node
Reading completion and repeated settlement do not duplicate memory
Knowledge tree distinguishes reading and reinforcement
Archive export contains the existing format and no model settings
Archive merge and restore work from React controls
Deleting memory excludes the associated evidence
Saved learning remains readable without network
No horizontal overflow at mobile and desktop widths

caveats: Chromium browser, not Android WebView or a physical phone.
Browser flow uses the explicitly labeled demo; real Pi pipeline is tested separately with simulated model transport.
Real model credentials, physical installation and Android lifecycle still need device acceptance.
